_purpose: Wave-7 (MX-K) full-depth ladder knobs.  Byte-identical to the wave-6 (MX-J) knob file, which is itself identical to wave 5's and to waves 1-3's, deliberately: this wave measures what happens when a proven component is installed at MORE SITES, so the only thing allowed to differ between a wave-6 rung and a wave-7 rung is the site.  A knob change here would make every row of the frontier curve a comparison between two experiments.
_calibration_tolerance_note: Unchanged from NOTES-MX-D 4 / MX-E / MX-F / MX-G / MX-I / MX-J: the evidence base is captured with a bfloat16 parent, so the sealed activation rows carry ~2^-9 relative quantization and the copy_exact calibration arm cannot beat that floor.  Waves 1-3 measured 0.000638-0.002282 across every component that could run the gate.
